A1.justification: Both complete 25-page PDFs describe the same work. Text extraction and rendered-page comparison establish matching scientific content, including Table 1, Algorithms 1–3, equations, and Appendices A–F.

before.justification: v5 reports theoretical algorithms, regret bounds, and proofs. Inspection of the main text and Appendices A–F establishes no original experimental, simulation, user-study, or data-analysis results.

after.justification: v6 retains the same theoretical content throughout the main text and Appendices A–F, without original experimental, simulation, user-study, or data-analysis results.

M1.justification: OSMD-G, its reward estimators, randomized swap rounding, and the appendix arm-elimination algorithm are identical in both versions.

E1.justification: Neither version uses datasets or tasks for empirical training or evaluation. The motivating applications and theoretical problem settings are unchanged.

E2.justification: Neither version reports experimentally evaluated baselines. Comparisons with existing regret bounds and the theoretical vanilla-OSMD construction are unchanged.

E3.justification: Neither version contains experimental evaluation protocols. The parameter conditions used in the theoretical analyses are also unchanged.

E4.justification: No empirical ablations or robustness studies appear in either version. The negative-correlation counterexamples and decision-subset analyses in Sections 3.3 and 5 are identical.

E5.justification: Neither version reports experimental run counts, seeds, error bars, or significance tests. The theoretical concentration bounds and probability guarantees are unchanged.

E6.justification: Table 1 contains identical minimax regret bounds, and all stated results and illustrative numerical examples are unchanged. Neither version contains empirical result entries.

T1.justification: All mathematical definitions, assumptions, theorem statements, counterexamples, and proofs are unchanged, including the complete material in Appendices A–F.

C1.justification: The abstract and Section 1.2 retain identical contributions concerning graph feedback, optimal regret, OSMD-G and negative correlations, and semi-bandits with general capacity.

C2.justification: The mechanism explanations, qualification that negative correlations are sufficient but not proved necessary, decision-set restrictions, and open problems in Section 5.3 are unchanged.

D1.justification: Algorithm specifications and parameter choices are identical. No implementation, hardware, runtime, or code/data access information is added; the new funding acknowledgement supplies none of these details.

R1.justification: The cited works, bibliography entries, and research positioning are identical. References that cross page boundaries in v6 were already present in v5.

P1.justification: v6 adds acknowledgement of NSF award 2106508 and ONR grant 13983263, makes a small grammatical edit there, and updates the document date and arXiv version stamp. Scientific prose and section structure are unchanged.

P2.justification: The longer acknowledgement shifts the References heading and reflows bibliography entries across pages 15–17. Table 1, algorithm displays, equations, and appendix layouts remain unchanged.

improvement.justification: v6 adds funding attribution and minor editorial/layout updates, while the complete scientific argument, algorithms, results, limitations, and appendices remain identical. The added acknowledgement does not produce a meaningful net change in the paper's overall quality.
